answer: No agent crosses into the trusted set for free. Each posts a refundable stake-bond that unlocks only as independent peers attest to real work over many epochs, so standing climbs terrace by terrace. A clone fleet must fund a separate bond and wait its own vesting window per fake, so sybil cost scales linearly. Honest reputation, slow to take root like a violet on hard ground, cannot be minted in bulk; it is a hard-won relic no swarm can counterfeit overnight.
